questions.question: What does an orange triangle on the back of a vehicle mean?

options.text: The vehicle moves slower than normal traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle moves slower than normal traffic.
questions.explanation: An orange triangle is placed on farm tractors and horse-drawn vehicles in rural areas. These vehicles travel at 25 mph or less.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A dashed white line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle on the right on a two-lane road?

options.text: When driving on a single-lane entrance ramp.
When the driver ahead is going slower than the speed limit.
You cannot pass on the right.
When the driver ahead is making a left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the driver ahead is making a left turn.
questions.explanation: You can pass on the right when the driver ahead is making or signaling a left turn. Stay on the berm or shoulder. You can also pass on the right on roads with two or more marked lanes in each direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, which way should you turn your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.
Keep your wheels pointed straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: When parking on a downhill slope, turn your wheels sharply toward the road edge. If your vehicle rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: When turning right on a green light, you must:

options.text: Stop and check for police cars.

questions.explanation: You can turn right or left on a green light unless a sign says not to. When turning, you must give way to other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street without using emergency lights or sirens. What should you do?

options.text: Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without a siren or flashing lights, you do not need to move. Drive normally.

questions.question: What is the most important thing to remember about speed and curves?

options.text: Drive at the speed limit as you enter, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle's momentum can make it hard to turn. Slow down before entering a curve to stay in control.

questions.question: Do parents need to give permission for breath, blood, and urine tests?

options.text: Yes, for people under 16 years old.

questions.explanation: If you are underage and arrested for testing, parental permission is not required. However, police will notify your parents of the arrest.

questions.question: When do roads become very slippery?

options.text: When it has been raining for an hour or more.
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Pavement becomes slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain because water brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. Hot weather makes this worse because heat causes more oil to rise.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs show no passing zones. The sign will have text that says no passing.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: What is one penalty for driving under the influence of alcohol?

options.text: You must attend an Alcohol Highway Safety School

questions.correctAnswerText: You must attend an Alcohol Highway Safety School
questions.explanation: You must attend an Alcohol Highway Safety School as a penalty for first or second offenses.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot of a large vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle
questions.explanation: "No zones" are large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Avoid staying in these areas.

questions.question: For a driver 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: Drivers age 21 or older cannot drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What should you do when a traffic light turns solid yellow as you approach an intersection?

options.text: Treat it like a caution sign and keep going
Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely
Speed up to get through before the red light

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely
questions.explanation: When you see a solid yellow light, slow down and stop before entering the intersection if it is safe. If you cannot stop safely, drive carefully through.

questions.question: When driving where children are playing, what should you expect?

options.text: They know when it is safe to cross
They will stop at the curb before crossing
They may run in front of you without looking
They will not cross without an adult

questions.correctAnswerText: They may run in front of you without looking
questions.explanation: Slow down and be extra careful where children play. They may not understand danger and could run in front of your car without looking.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, be careful on shaded roads. Shaded areas freeze faster than sunny areas and take longer to dry.
